The Boss must navigate simulations based on the personal nightmares of each character. In response, Zinyak floods the Steelport simulation with copies of gang members the Boss faced in the past, causing Kinzie to become overwhelmed.

Al Jazeera English is a Qatari-based news channel that provides journalism committed to nationalist, pan-Arab, and humanitarian issues within the template of professional journalistic objectivity. The channel presents itself as a "free speech" network and has gained prominence during the Arab Spring revolutions, where it covered popular actions on the squares of change.

There is an ongoing controversy regarding intellectual property (IP) laws and whether they truly operate to confer the stated public benefits. Critics argue that the protection provided by IP laws may not be appropriate in the context of innovation derived from traditional knowledge and folklore, as well as patents for software and business methods. This controversy manifests in different ways across different jurisdictions.
